weekLabel: Travel week · Sat Nov 21 pack · Mon Nov 23 – Sun Nov 29
notes: TRAVEL WEEK (from our calendar + confirmations): Sun Nov 22 drive to Embassy Suites Panama City Beach (2 nights), Tue Nov 24 drive to the Creekside Cabin in Pigeon Forge (through Sun Nov 29), Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26 at the cabin. Chloe's school is on break Nov 20–30, so no school lunches. No Sunday batch cook: a 2-hour Sat Nov 21 morning session makes the road-trip 'fire' boxes; cabin dinners are cooked fresh. Small home order + cabin groceries bought in person Tue (Whole Foods Knoxville + Publix Pigeon Forge for Maple Hill). Mild for Chloe and Wendy, heat on the side for Rory. Quality: organic; beef grass-fed; chicken organic AND air-chilled only; seafood wild-caught; eggs OrgaNICK at home (WF organic pasture-raised at the cabin); yogurt Maple Hill (Publix). Rice in bone broth; gelatin in beef. Low oil. Named sides. Macros are estimates.

dinners.name: Panama City Beach: dinner out (no cooking)
dinners.desc: Hotel day. Breakfast = Embassy Suites free cooked-to-order breakfast (Rory: 3-egg omelet or eggs + fruit). Lunch = Saturday's 'fire' boxes from the suite fridge (Chloe's below). Dinner out: order grilled (not fried) wild Gulf fish or a plain-grilled steak with steamed veg and rice or a baked potato; ask for sauce on the side. Rory's target ~600 cal / 45 g+ protein ≈ a 7–8 oz grilled fish fillet + 1 cup rice or a small potato + veg. Move the Tue boxes to the fridge tonight; ask the front desk to freeze the ice packs.

dinners.name: Cabin arrival skillet: grass-fed beef, zucchini & peppers over bone broth rice
dinners.desc: Drive day (checkout 11 AM CT; ~6½ hr to Pigeon Forge, which is Eastern time). Lunch = the last 'fire' boxes. Stop at Whole Foods Knoxville (6730 Papermill Dr NW, right off I-40/I-75 exit 383, open to 9 PM) for the cabin groceries, then Publix Pigeon Forge (2656 Parkway) for Maple Hill. Dinner is one pan in 25 minutes, using the bone broth rice you froze Saturday. Mild; hot sauce for Rory. Make extra for Wednesday's lunch.
dinners.side: Broth-sautéed zucchini and red pepper (in the skillet)

recipe.serves: 3 tonight + 3 Wed lunches (~1,670 g cooked skillet mix: Rory 320 g · Wendy 260 · Chloe 130, ×2; ~250 g spare)
ingredients: 3 lb (1.36 kg) organic grass-fed 93% lean ground beef (Whole Foods Knoxville)
5 g (1½ tsp) unflavored gelatin bloomed in 60 g bone broth (brought from home)
1 medium yellow onion, diced (~150 g); 3 garlic cloves, minced
2 medium zucchini (~400 g), diced ½ in; 2 red bell peppers (~300 g), diced
120 g bone broth (+ the 60 g with the gelatin)
1¾ tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp dried oregano (spice kit)
Rice (Rory 140 · Wendy 120 · Chloe 100, ×2 = 720 g): 370 g bone broth rice frozen Saturday + 140 g jasmine (left from the home bag) cooked in 250 g bone broth at the cabin (→ ~350 g)
Rory only: hot sauce or chili crisp; optional fried egg for anyone (organic pasture-raised eggs from WF)
steps: Start the extra rice (140 g jasmine + 250 g broth, boil, cover, low 15 min, rest 10) and bloom the gelatin in 60 g broth while you unload.
12-in skillet (or the cabin's largest pan), medium-high, light spray. Beef in, break it up, cook 7–8 min until no pink and browned in spots; drain any excess fat.
Add onion and garlic 3 min, then the zucchini, peppers, spices and 120 g broth; cover 4 min, uncover 2–3 min until the veg is tender-crisp and the liquid is mostly gone.
Stir in the bloomed gelatin 1 min (glossy, juicy). Taste for salt. Beef should read 160°F.
Rice: microwave covered with 2 Tbsp broth 2–3 min to steaming.
Before serving, pack 3 Wed lunches into glass containers → cabin fridge: Rory 320 g skillet mix + 140 g rice · Wendy 260 g + 120 g · Chloe 130 g + 100 g.
Rory: 320 g skillet mix (≈170 g beef + 150 g zucchini-pepper) + 140 g rice ≈ 566 cal / 56 g P.
recipe.leftovers: 3 Wed lunches (fridge). Spare beef → Thu breakfast eggs.

dinners.name: Lemon chicken & rice soup + lemon-garlic roasted broccoli
dinners.desc: Cold mountain night, so a big pot of mild Greek-style lemon chicken and rice soup: air-chilled thighs simmered in bone broth with carrots and celery, finished with egg-lemon for a silky, creamy texture (no cream). Lemon-garlic roasted broccoli on the side. Doubles as Thursday's light Thanksgiving lunch. Also today: cranberry sauce + turkey dry-brine for tomorrow (10 min).

recipe.serves: 3 tonight + 3 Thu lunches (~3,000 g soup: Rory 600 g · Wendy 500 · Chloe 300, ×2)
ingredients: 2 lb (907 g) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken thighs (WF Knoxville), whole
1,700 g (about 1¾ × 32 oz cartons) organic bone broth + 300 g water
1 medium yellow onion (~150 g), diced; 3 carrots (~250 g), sliced ¼ in; 3 celery ribs (~150 g), sliced; 3 garlic cloves, minced
180 g organic jasmine rice, rinsed
2 organic pasture-raised eggs + 60 g lemon juice (2 lemons) + zest of 1 lemon
1½ tsp kosher salt (adjust; broth varies), ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp dried thyme or oregano, 10 g chopped fresh dill or parsley

Broccoli (~300 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 50): 1.5 lb broccoli crowns in florets (~550 g trimmed; save ~200 g for Fri), spray, ¼ tsp salt, 1 garlic clove grated, zest of ½ lemon + 1 tsp juice
Rory only: red pepper flakes or hot sauce
steps: 5:00: 5–6 qt pot, medium, light spray: onion, carrots, celery 5 min (splash of broth if they stick); garlic 30 s.
Add the broth, water, thyme, salt, pepper and the whole thighs. Bring to a boil, then a lazy simmer, partly covered, 20 min until the thighs are 175°F.
5:25: thighs to a board; stir the rice into the pot, simmer 15 min until tender. Shred the chicken with two forks.
5:25: oven to 425°F; broccoli on a parchment-lined sheet pan, spray, salt; roast 15–18 min until browned at the edges. Toss with garlic, zest and lemon.

5:40: egg-lemon: whisk eggs, lemon juice and zest in a bowl; slowly whisk in 2 ladles of hot broth (tempering so the eggs don't scramble). Heat off, stir it back into the pot with the chicken; it turns silky. Don't boil again. Soup ≥165°F. Dill on top.
Pack 3 Thu lunches first (Rory 600 g · Wendy 500 · Chloe 300) into containers → fridge.
Rory: 600 g soup + 150 g broccoli ≈ 550 cal / 56 g P.
Tonight (10 min): make the cranberry sauce and dry-brine the turkey (see Thanksgiving).
recipe.leftovers: 3 Thu lunches (fridge). Soup thickens overnight; loosen with a splash of broth when reheating.

dinners.name: Thanksgiving at the cabin: herb-roasted turkey breast, broth gravy, Maple Hill mash, lemon-garlic green beans, honey-orange cranberry
dinners.desc: A simple, healthy Thanksgiving for the 3 of us (assumption: just us at the cabin, no other plans found). Organic bone-in turkey breast instead of a whole bird (one pan, ~2 hr, no carving drama), a butter-free bone broth gravy, Yukon mash with Maple Hill instead of cream, green beans, and honey-sweetened cranberry. Dessert: pumpkin-honey Maple Hill mousse right after dinner. Dinner at ~4:30 PM so Rory's 2+ hr fast before bedtime still works. Light lunch = Wednesday's soup.

recipe.serves: 3 tonight + Fri lunch ×3, Sat lunch ×3, Sun road boxes ×3 (cooked turkey ~1,700 g: Rory 180–200 g · Wendy 140–150 · Chloe 70 per meal)
recipe.time: Dry-brine Wed night · ~2 hr at 325°F · dinner ~4:30 PM
ingredients: 1 organic bone-in, skin-on turkey breast, 6–7 lb (2.7–3.2 kg) (Whole Foods Knoxville; Thanksgiving week, so call (865) 291-6400 to hold one if you want to be sure)
Dry brine (Wed night): 15 g (1 Tbsp + ½ tsp) kosher salt + 1 tsp pepper + 1 tsp dried thyme + ½ tsp garlic powder
Herbs: 1 poultry herb pack (sage, thyme, rosemary), 1 lemon halved, 1 onion quartered, 4 garlic cloves, avocado-oil spray
Gravy (~360 g; Rory 60 · Wendy 50 · Chloe 30 + leftovers): pan drippings (fat skimmed off) + 400 g bone broth + 12 g (4 tsp) arrowroot whisked into 30 g cold water + ¼ tsp salt, pinch of pepper
Maple Hill mash (~900 g; Rory 180 · Wendy 150 · Chloe 100 tonight, rest Sat lunch): 900 g Yukon Golds peeled and cubed, 150 g warm bone broth, 120 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt, ¾ tsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper

Lemon-garlic green beans (~780 g cooked for tonight + Fri + Sat lunches; Rory 120 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 40 each): 2 lb green beans trimmed, 200 g bone broth, 3 garlic cloves sliced, zest of 1 lemon + 2 tsp juice, ½ tsp salt
Honey-orange cranberry sauce (Wed night; ~420 g): 12 oz (340 g) fresh cranberries, 85 g honey, zest of 1 orange + 80 g orange juice, 60 g water, pinch of salt
steps: WED NIGHT: pat the turkey dry, rub the brine all over and under the skin; uncovered on a plate in the fridge overnight. Cranberry: simmer everything 10–12 min until most berries pop and it thickens (it sets more as it cools); fridge.
1:45 PM THU: turkey out of the fridge. 2:00: oven to 325°F, rack in the lower third. Onion, lemon, garlic and herbs in a 9×13 or roasting pan; turkey skin-up on top; spray the skin.
2:15: roast ~1¾–2¼ hr (about 18–20 min/lb) until the thickest part reads 160°F, not touching bone. If the skin is pale at 150°F, raise to 425°F for the last 10 min.
3:30: potatoes in a pot of cold salted water, boil 15–18 min until a knife slides in; drain, mash with the warm broth, Maple Hill, salt and pepper. Lid on, low heat.
~4:05: turkey out (160°F); tent with foil 20–25 min (carryover to 165°F).

4:10: gravy: pour the pan drippings into a measuring cup, spoon off the fat, add to a small pot with the broth; simmer, whisk in the arrowroot slurry, 1–2 min until it coats a spoon (don't over-boil arrowroot).
4:15: green beans in a wide lidded pan with the broth and garlic, covered 6–7 min, uncover 1–2 min to cook off the liquid; zest, juice, salt.
4:30: slice the turkey off the bone. Rory: 180 g turkey (no skin), 180 g mash, 120 g beans, 60 g gravy, 30 g cranberry ≈ 522 cal / 64 g P.

After dinner: pack Fri lunch ×3 (Rory 200 g turkey + 120 g rice* + 120 g beans + 50 g gravy + 20 g cranberry; Wendy 150 g; Chloe 70 g), Sat lunch ×3 (same, with the leftover mash in place of rice), and keep ~420 g turkey for Sun road boxes. *Cook 300 g jasmine in 520 g broth Fri morning (→ ~750 g) for Fri lunch + Sun road boxes.
Dessert: pumpkin-honey mousse (see Creami/desserts).
recipe.leftovers: Fri lunch ×3, Sat lunch ×3, Sun road boxes ×3 (fridge). Turkey keeps 3–4 days in the fridge; the Sunday boxes ride in the cooler on ice.

dinners.name: Lemon-dill wild coho salmon + sweet potato wedges + roasted broccoli
dinners.desc: A light, fresh break from turkey: wild coho baked low-oil with lemon and dill, roasted sweet potato wedges, the last of the broccoli, and a dill-lemon Maple Hill sauce. Mild; chili crisp for Rory. 30 minutes. Lunch = turkey bowls.

ingredients: 1.25 lb (567 g) wild-caught coho salmon fillet, cut in 3 (WF Knoxville; frozen at the cabin Tue, fridge Thu morning)
Zest of 1 lemon + 1 Tbsp juice, 5 g chopped dill, ½ tsp kosher salt, ¼ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder, spray
Sweet potato wedges (Rory 180 · Wendy 150 · Chloe 80 cooked): 2 lb (900 g) sweet potatoes in ¾-in wedges, spray, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp smoked paprika, split across 2 parchment-lined sheet pans
Broccoli: the ~200 g saved from Wed + any left (~300 g raw total), spray, salt, lemon
Dill-lemon sauce (~100 g; Rory 30 · Wendy 30 · Chloe 15): 80 g Maple Hill Greek, 5 g dill, 8 g lemon juice, ½ garlic clove grated, 1 g salt
steps: 5:00: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle. Sweet potatoes in on both pans, 25–28 min, flipping at 15 min, until browned and tender.
Stir the sauce together; fridge.
5:12: salmon skin-side down on a parchment-lined pan (or a third of a potato pan), spray, salt, pepper, garlic powder, zest. Broccoli on the remaining space.
5:15: salmon + broccoli in, 12–14 min until the salmon reaches 145°F and flakes (pull Chloe's smaller piece 2 min early). Lemon juice and dill on top.
Rory: 190 g cooked salmon, 180 g sweet potatoes, 150 g broccoli, 30 g sauce ≈ 512 cal / 55 g P.

dinners.name: Night out in Pigeon Forge / Gatlinburg
dinners.desc: Standing night out, no prep. Lunch = Thanksgiving turkey bowls (packed Thu). Tonight, pack the cooler for tomorrow: Sun road boxes (turkey + rice + green beans), fruit, Maple Hill; freeze the ice packs in the cabin freezer.

dinners.name: Drive home (checkout) · road cooler turkey boxes
dinners.desc: Long drive back (~12 hr). Breakfast at the cabin with the last eggs and fruit; lunch from the cooler: turkey boxes (Rory 200 g turkey + 120 g bone broth rice + 120 g green beans; Wendy 150 g; Chloe 70 g + 100 g rice + fruit). Dinner: whatever is easiest on the road or at home. No batch cook today; next week's plan (made next Thursday) will move the cook to Mon Nov 30 or plan a light first week back.

dinners.date: Sat Nov 21 (before the trip; replaces the Sun Nov 22 batch cook)
dinners.name: Road-trip 'fire' boxes + cooler pack (Sat 9:30–11:30 AM)
dinners.desc: We leave Sunday morning, so there's no Sunday batch cook this week. Instead, a 2-hour Saturday-morning session makes 9 'fire' lunch boxes (Sun road lunch, Mon at the beach, Tue drive day) plus Chloe's three road lunches and Tuesday's cabin rice. Saturday night out is unchanged. The Ninja Creami stays home this week.

recipe.serves: 9 grown-up boxes (Rory 3 × 200 g chicken · Wendy 3 × 150 g) + Chloe 3 × 70 g + Tue cabin rice
recipe.time: ~2 hr, 9:30–11:30 AM Sat (delivery must arrive Fri evening or Sat by 9 AM)
ingredients: 4.5 lb (2.04 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken breasts, thick ends pounded to ¾ in (→ ~1,430 g cooked; need 1,260 g + spare)
Lemon-oregano rub: zest of 2 lemons + 50 g lemon juice, 4 g (2 tsp) dried oregano, 7 g (2½ tsp) garlic powder, 3 g (1½ tsp) smoked paprika, 13 g (2¼ tsp) kosher salt, ¾ tsp pepper, avocado-oil spray
Bone broth rice: 560 g organic jasmine rice, rinsed + 970 g organic bone broth + ½ tsp salt (→ ~1,400 g cooked: 9 boxes 1,020 g + Tue cabin dinner 370 g)
Peas and carrots (need ~790 g cooked): 2 × 16 oz bags organic frozen peas and carrots, 60 g bone broth, ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp honey, juice of ½ lemon

Aji verde (~250 g; 6 steel cups × 40 g for Rory + Wendy Sun/Mon/Tue): 180 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt, 30 g cilantro, 15 g grated parmesan, 15 g lime juice, 1 garlic clove, 3 g salt. Rory's cups: + ½ jalapeño or hot sauce.
Road snacks: 1 English cucumber + 2 red bell peppers in spears (~450 g), 1 lb strawberries washed + dried, mandarins and apples whole
steps: 9:30: rinse the rice; 4–5 qt saucepan with the broth and salt, boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min, off heat 10 min. Fluff, spread on a sheet pan to cool (fridge within 1 hour).
9:35: toss the chicken with the rub; spray lightly.
9:40 / 10:00 / 10:20: air-fry 1½ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min, single layer, flipping halfway, to 165°F in the thickest part. Rest 5 min, slice.
10:05: peas and carrots in a covered 12-in pan with the broth, medium 6–7 min until hot; season with salt, honey, lemon. Spread on a plate to cool.
10:20: blend the aji verde 30 s; 6 lidded steel cups × 40 g (mark Rory's 3 spicy). Fridge.
10:30: cut the cucumber and pepper spears; wash the strawberries.
10:45: portion (weigh): Rory boxes 200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas/carrots; Wendy boxes 150 + 120 + 100; Chloe 70 g chicken + 100 g rice (+ 40 g peas/carrots in her Mon box).
FRIDGE: Sun boxes (3) + Mon boxes (3) + aji verde cups. FREEZER: Tue boxes (3) + Tue cabin rice 370 g in a flat zip bag (they double as ice packs in the cooler).
Rory's box ≈ 633 cal · 77 g P · 55 g C · 10 g F with 40 g aji verde; Wendy's ≈ 497 cal · 61 g P.
11:15: clean up; done by 11:30. Saturday night out as usual.
recipe.scale: Same 'fire' lunch as every week (200 g lemon-oregano chicken · 120 g bone broth rice · 150 g peas and carrots · 40 g aji verde), sized for 3 road days.
recipe.leftovers: All 9 boxes + Chloe's 3 go in the cooler Sunday. Tue boxes are frozen so they stay safe until Tuesday.

sideRecipes.title: Cooler pack + food safety (Sun Nov 22, 6:00 AM)
ingredients: Hard cooler, 6 frozen ice packs, cooler thermometer
Frozen: Tue boxes (3) + Tue cabin rice
Cold: Sun + Mon boxes, Chloe's lunches, 6 aji verde cups, Maple Hill (opened tubs), spears, strawberries, mandarins, apples
steps: Ice packs and the frozen Tue boxes on the bottom, Mon boxes next, Sun lunch boxes + snacks on top. Thermometer inside: keep it at 40°F or below; add bagged ice at a gas stop if it creeps up.
Sun lunch on the road: eat the boxes cold (chicken-rice boxes are fine cold), or warm them at a stop that has a microwave. Chloe's Sun box: 70 g chicken + 100 g rice + mandarin + strawberries.
Check-in (4 PM CT): everything straight into the suite fridge. Mon night: move the Tue boxes and Tue rice from the freezer/cooler into the fridge so they're thawed by lunch.
Tue checkout (11 AM CT): repack the cooler with refrozen packs (ask the front desk to freeze them overnight Mon) for the Tue lunch boxes, rice, and leftovers.

chloeLunches.items: Beach-day lunch (no school, Thanksgiving break): 70 g lemon-oregano chicken + 100 g bone broth rice + 40 g peas and carrots (Saturday box, suite fridge); 1 mandarin + 5 strawberries
chloeLunches.how: Microwave the box covered 1½–2 min, stirring, to 165°F (suite microwave). For the beach: preheat the thermal jar with hot water from the room coffee maker, pack hot, eat within 4 hours. Fruit in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: Car lunch on the drive: 70 g lemon chicken + 100 g bone broth rice (Saturday box, frozen → thawed Mon night); apple slices + a mandarin
chloeLunches.how: Before checkout: microwave to 165°F, pack hot in the preheated thermal jar; eat by ~3 PM. Apple and mandarin in the bento.

chloeLunches.items: Cabin lunch: 130 g beef-zucchini skillet + 100 g bone broth rice (packed Tue night); 1 kiwi + a handful of blueberries
chloeLunches.how: Microwave covered 1½–2 min to 165°F (or warm in a small pan with 1 Tbsp water). Eat at the table or pack in the jar for an outing.

chloeLunches.items: Thanksgiving light lunch: 300 g lemon chicken & rice soup (from Wed); ½ banana + apple slices
chloeLunches.how: Warm in a small pot over medium 4–5 min, stirring, to 165°F (don't boil, the egg-lemon stays silky). Big dinner at 4:30.

breakfasts: Sat Nov 21 + Sun Nov 22 (home): eggs from our usual Sprouts carton (OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free) + fruit; Rory's Maple Hill bowl.
Mon Nov 23 + Tue Nov 24 (Embassy Suites, free cooked-to-order breakfast): Rory = 3-egg omelet or eggs + fruit (skip the pastries); Chloe = eggs + fruit + a small pancake or toast.

Wed–Sun at the cabin: organic pasture-raised eggs (bought at Whole Foods Knoxville, since OrgaNICK is a Sprouts-only brand) scrambled with spray + fruit; Maple Hill bowls (Publix Pigeon Forge) with berries or kiwi, honey optional, no granola. Thu: spare skillet beef in the eggs.

Rory's daily snacks (unchanged): Jacob bar pre-workout (pack 1/day); 3 PM = 136 g Maple Hill + 35 g Equip chocolate peanut butter + 182 g apple (bring the Equip tub and the scale). Dessert right after dinner, then nothing until bed (CJC/ipamorelin).
lunches: Grown-up lunches: Sun (road) + Mon (beach) + Tue (drive) = Saturday's 'fire' boxes (Rory 200 g lemon-oregano chicken + 120 g bone broth rice + 150 g peas and carrots + 40 g aji verde ≈ 633 cal / 77 g P; Wendy 150 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas and carrots). Wed = Tue's beef skillet. Thu = Wed's lemon chicken soup (light, before the 4:30 dinner). Fri = turkey bowls (200 g turkey + 120 g bone broth rice + 120 g green beans + gravy + cranberry ≈ 542 cal / 70 g P). Sat = turkey + mash bowls. Sun = turkey road boxes.

creami.name: Ninja Creami: paused this week
creami.desc: The Creami stays home while we travel, so no pints are blended. Any pints left in the freezer keep for when we're back. Desserts below are honey-sweetened, use Maple Hill, and need only a cabin kitchen.

creami.name: Honey-cinnamon baked apples + vanilla Maple Hill (Wed)
creami.desc: 3 apples halved and cored, sprinkle of cinnamon, 15 g honey drizzled, 30 g water in the pan, covered with foil at 375°F 25 min (while the broccoli roasts after it). Vanilla yogurt: 255 g Maple Hill + 20 g Noble vanilla isolate + 5 g honey + ½ tsp vanilla. Rory: 1 apple (2 halves) + 90 g yogurt ≈ 210 cal · 16 g P.

creami.name: Pumpkin-honey Maple Hill mousse (Thanksgiving, makes 4)
creami.desc: 200 g organic pumpkin purée, 340 g Maple Hill Greek, 30 g Noble vanilla isolate, 30 g honey, 3 g pumpkin pie spice, ½ tsp vanilla, pinch of salt. Whisk smooth, spoon into 4 cups, chill 1 hr+ (make Thu morning). Each ≈ 196 cal · 17 g P. The 4th cup is Fri's dessert.

creami.name: Fri + Sat dessert
creami.desc: Fri: the 4th mousse cup + baked apple halves left from Wed (warm 1 min). Sat: night out.

creami.name: Notes
creami.desc: Totals to buy for desserts: apples (in the 8), pumpkin purée 1 can, Maple Hill (in the Publix tubs). Bring from home: Noble vanilla isolate ~50 g, honey, vanilla, cinnamon, pumpkin pie spice. Macros are estimates.

prep.title: Order (after Rory's okay)
prep.step: Only the small home order: 4.5 lb air-chilled chicken (WF), rice, broth, peas and carrots, aji verde herbs, road fruit/veg, eggs, Maple Hill (Publix). Schedule delivery for Fri evening or Sat by 9 AM.

prep.title: Clear the fridge
prep.step: Eat or freeze anything from last week that won't be eaten by Saturday (leftover chicken/beef → freezer, labeled). Freeze 6 ice packs. Charge the cooler thermometer; pack the gear bag (scale, thermometers, LunchBots jar, spices, gelatin, honey, Noble, Equip, Jacob bars, spray, hot sauce).

prep.title: Rice on
prep.step: 560 g rinsed jasmine + 970 g bone broth + ½ tsp salt in a 4–5 qt pot: boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min, off heat 10 min (→ ~1,400 g). Spread to cool on a sheet pan; fridge within 1 hr.

prep.title: Season chicken
prep.step: 4.5 lb air-chilled breasts, pounded to ¾ in, tossed with lemon zest + juice, oregano, garlic powder, paprika, salt, pepper; spray.

prep.title: Air fryer (3 batches)
prep.step: 1½ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min, flipping halfway, to 165°F: batches at 9:40, 10:00, 10:20. Rest 5 min; slice.

prep.title: Peas and carrots
prep.step: 2 bags in a covered 12-in pan with 60 g broth, 6–7 min; salt, honey, lemon. Cool on a plate.

prep.title: Aji verde
prep.step: Blend 180 g Maple Hill, 30 g cilantro, 15 g parmesan, 15 g lime, 1 garlic, 3 g salt; 6 cups × 40 g (Rory's 3 with jalapeño). Fridge.

prep.title: Road snacks
prep.step: Cucumber + 2 red peppers into spears; wash and dry strawberries; mandarins and apples whole.

prep.title: Portion + label
prep.step: Rory ×3 (200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas/carrots) · Wendy ×3 (150 + 120 + 100) · Chloe ×3 (70 g chicken + 100 g rice; + 40 g peas/carrots in Mon's). FRIDGE: Sun + Mon boxes, aji cups. FREEZER: Tue boxes + 370 g Tue cabin rice (flat bag). Label dish / day / grams / 'cooked 11/21'.

prep.title: Clean up
prep.step: Done by 11:30. Saturday night out as usual.

prep.title: Cooler + go
prep.step: Ice packs + frozen Tue boxes on the bottom, Mon boxes, then Sun lunch boxes, aji cups, Maple Hill, fruit/spears on top; thermometer ≤40°F. Leave ~6:30 AM ET; Panama City Beach check-in 4 PM CT. Everything into the suite fridge on arrival.

prep.title: Cabin schedule
prep.step: Mon night: Tue boxes → suite fridge; front desk freezes the ice packs. Tue: Whole Foods Knoxville + Publix Pigeon Forge on the way in; freeze the coho; skillet dinner. Wed night: cranberry sauce + dry-brine the turkey. Thu: mousse in the AM, turkey in at 2:15, dinner 4:30. Thu AM: coho → fridge. Fri AM: cook 300 g rice in 520 g broth for Fri lunch + Sun boxes. Sat night: pack the cooler for Sunday.

lunchIntro: No school this week (Thanksgiving break). When Chloe's lunch travels: fill the 12 oz thermal jar with boiling or very hot water 5–10 min (hotel coffee maker works), dump, pack food heated to 165°F, close. Cold food in the steel bento with an ice pack, all in the insulated bag.
prepIntro: Travel week. Times assume a 9:30 AM Saturday start with the delivery already in (order for Fri evening or Sat by 9 AM). About 2 hours, mostly hands-off air-fryer time; Saturday night out is unchanged. At the cabin, dinners are cooked fresh (25 min Tue, 55 min Wed soup, ~2½ hr mostly-oven Thanksgiving, 30 min Fri) with no batch cook.
prepSafety: Chicken 165°F (thighs best at 175°F); ground beef 160°F; turkey breast out at 160°F, rests to 165°F; salmon 145°F; reheated leftovers 165°F.

Cooler: 40°F or below the whole drive (thermometer inside); frozen Tue boxes act as ice packs. Into the suite or cabin fridge as soon as you arrive. Toss anything that sat above 40°F for more than 2 hours.
Saturday boxes: Sun + Mon from the fridge, Tue from frozen (thawed Mon night). Cabin leftovers eaten within 3–4 days; Thanksgiving turkey through Sunday's road lunch (day 3).
Thermal jar: preheat with boiling or very hot water, pack food at 165°F, eat within 4 hours. Reheat each portion only once.
prepThaw: Sat Nov 21: Tue boxes + Tue cabin rice → freezer (they ride frozen in the cooler).
Mon Nov 23 night: Tue boxes + rice → suite fridge.
Tue Nov 24: at the cabin, coho → freezer; turkey, beef, thighs → fridge.
Wed Nov 25 night: dry-brine the turkey (uncovered, fridge); cranberry sauce.
Thu Nov 26 morning: coho → fridge (for Fri); mousse made and chilled.
Sat Nov 28 night: freeze ice packs; pack Sunday's road boxes.
